description: Rows of internal/lokierr/testdata/loki_error_answers.jsonl (real Loki 3.7.9 error answers recorded over HTTP) whose proxy answer is not Loki's yet, compared by TestLokiErrorAnswersReplay on status, Content-Type, X-Content-Type-Options and body, byte for byte, against a proxy with its default configuration and Loki's max_query_length of the recorded stack, in front of a VictoriaLogs stand-in that answers every query call with an empty valid answer (so a request the proxy forwards instead of rejecting shows as a 200). The list may only shrink: a row that newly differs fails the test, a listed row that now matches fails until it is removed, and ceiling equals the number of rows. proxy is today's answer, for the reader; the test compares only whether a row matches Loki.
